skill.name: draft-nda-template
skill.title: Draft an NDA Template
skill.description: Drafts a company's own mutual or one-way non-disclosure agreement template from scratch, with standard clauses and fill-in fields.
use_when: a company needs its own NDA template
drafting a new confidentiality agreement rather than reviewing one

skill.name: supplier-contract-reviewer
skill.title: Supplier Contract Reviewer
skill.description: Reviews supplier, vendor and software service agreements for a small business, focusing on liability, indemnity, termination and payment terms.
use_when: reviewing a vendor or supplier agreement before signing
checking indemnity and limitation of liability clauses
reviewing SaaS terms of service for a business purchase

skill.name: contract-dispute-prep
skill.title: Contract Dispute Preparation
skill.description: Helps a business prepare for a contract dispute or breach claim with a lawyer, organising facts, documents and a timeline.
use_when: being sued or threatened with a claim for breach of contract
preparing documents for a meeting with a litigation lawyer

skill.name: code-reviewer
skill.title: Review Code Changes
skill.description: Reviews a code change for correctness, security and maintainability, and gives prioritised, actionable comments.
use_when: reviewing a pull request or diff before it is merged
checking a function or module for bugs and security holes
ranking review comments as blocking, should fix or nit

skill.name: employment-contract-drafter
skill.title: Employment Contract Drafter
skill.description: Drafts employment contracts and offer letters for new hires, with salary, duties, notice period and confidentiality terms.
use_when: hiring a new employee and needing a written contract
turning agreed offer terms into an offer letter
